attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf using both `blacklist usb-storage` (prevents automatic udev-triggered load) and `install usb-storage /bin/false` (prevents explicit modprobe load). Verified immediate enforcement, then performed the mandatory single-node restart with boot-identity proof and post-reboot re-verification confirming the module stayed blocked.
